prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep my name off the recording, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the parking lot of a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I had just pulled into a space near the main entrance.
Q: Were you driving, or were you parked?
A: I was driving. I was backing out of the space when another vehicle came down the aisle and clipped the rear of my car.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were going at the time of impact?
A: I was barely moving, maybe three or four miles an hour. It was more of a bump than a crash.
Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before it reached you?
A: Not really. I was checking my mirror on the driver's side and didn't see it until the contact.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle and speak with the other driver?
A: Yes, we exchanged information. He seemed fine and apologized.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. My lower back was sore and tight, and they diagnosed a back strain.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any pain or limitations?
A: Yes, I have trouble sitting for long periods and bending over. I've been doing some stretching and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your back?
A: I missed two days and I'm working lighter duty now. My employer has been accommodating.
Q: Before this collision, had you ever injured your back or received treatment for back pain?
A: Not that I can recall. I've had normal aches now and then, but nothing that required a doctor.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd appreciate a prompt response on the claim.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thanks for your time.
